companies.name: 100ms
companies.description: 100ms is a live-video infrastructure platform that provides subscription-based products to its customers. The company provides a low-code solution for companies looking to add video/audio conferencing within their own applications. The increasingly virtual, remote-first world needs an infrastructure provider that allows these experiences to happen seamlessly. 100ms' best-in-class quality and ease of use are fueling this revolution. Making live video work—our team has been obsessed with this problem for years and solved it at world-class scales for different network and device conditions. A great infrastructure provider also needs to have the shortest integration time—so our foundation is built on the above two principles.

companies.name: 1Balance
companies.description: 1Balance is a personalized nutrition company that helps you be in your optimally balanced healthy zone more often. At 1Balance, our aim is to combine the best of traditional medicine, herbal science, and personalization to create nutritional supplements and foods that are made with the highest quality natural ingredients, just for you. We strongly believe that healthcare should be personal and holistic. Our Personalization technology goes beyond just standard deficiencies, into your body type and needs, and maps it with the latest in herbal science research and the knowledge of the experts in practices like Yoga, Ayurveda, Diet and Nutrition, and Naturopathy.

companies.name: 1Password
companies.description:
1Password is a secure password manager that provides businesses and families with a safe way to share passwords, credit cards, and documents. It keeps important information secure with AES 256-bit encryption. They allow users to keep the information easily organized with convenient categories and tags and find what they need with a customizable search.

Founded in 2005, 1Password remembers and fills web forms with passwords, credit card information, and addresses—with a single click. It is focused on making security convenient and keeping customers happy. It is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, in Canada.

companies.name: 6sense
companies.description: 6sense reinvents the way organizations create, manage, and convert pipelines to revenue. 6sense Revenue AI captures anonymous buying signals, targets the right accounts, and recommends the channels and messages to boost revenue performance. Removing guesswork, friction, and wasted sales effort, 6sense empowers sales, marketing, and customer success teams to significantly improve pipeline quality, accelerate sales velocity, increase conversion rates, and grow revenue predictably.

companies.name: 99designs
companies.description:
99designs is the global creative platform that makes it easy for designers and clients to work together to create designs they love. Their tried-and-true creative process has become the go-to solution for businesses, agencies, and individuals.

Since 2008, 99designs has grown from a small online forum into a global community of talented designers. Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, with offices in Oakland, California, and Berlin, Germany, 99designs champions creativity to bring opportunities to people around the world.

companies.name: Aavenir
companies.description:
Aavenir is a Software-as-a-Service-based source-to-pay solutions provider. It revolutionizes age-old procurement processes by using the latest Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing technologies to reduce cycle time, yet offering insightful best practices suggestions based on historical data.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, Texas.
locations: Pasquinelli Hidden Creek Estates, Plano, TX, USA

companies.name: Acalvio Technologies
companies.description: Acalvio is an AI-powered preemptive cybersecurity company focused on countering AI-driven identity and infrastructure intrusion. Its 360 Deception platform combines Dynamic Deception, evolving HoneyPaths, and cloaking of production assets within deception fabric to disrupt automated reconnaissance, credential abuse, and lateral movement across identity systems, endpoints, cloud, network, and cyber-physical environments. By altering what attackers can perceive and trust, Acalvio shifts detection from post-compromise analysis to pre-impact exposure, enabling organizations to detect, delay, disrupt, and deny malicious activity at machine speed. The company serves enterprise and government organizations determined to break automated intrusion at its source.

companies.name: Accacia
companies.description: Accacia is an AI-enabled real-estate decarbonization platform that allows RE and infrastructure owners, developers, asset managers, and operators to measure, track, and manage their climate risks.

companies.name: ACKO
companies.description: Acko is a digital insurance company that provides a range of general insurance products through a direct-to-consumer model. The company offers services including motor insurance, health insurance, and employee group health coverage. Acko operates with a technology-driven approach, utilizing data analytics and digital platforms to streamline the purchase, management, and claims process for policyholders. Its motor insurance policies cover private vehicles and two-wheelers, with services such as instant policy issuance and paperless claims. In health insurance, Acko provides personalized plans with features like zero waiting period and flexible benefits. For businesses, Acko delivers group health insurance solutions with digital onboarding, claims support, and wellness programs for employees. The company partners with platforms in sectors such as e-commerce, mobility, and travel to distribute its embedded insurance products.

companies.name: AdRoll
companies.description: AdRoll is a connected advertising platform built for growth-minded marketers. With powerful AI, flexible campaign tools, and seamless integrations, AdRoll helps mid-sized businesses turn complexity into clarity and clicks into customers. The AdRoll platform delivers full-funnel performance through multi-channel advertising, audience insights, and cross-channel attribution, supporting marketers across industries including Ecommerce, Technology, Financial Services, Education, and more. For B2B teams, AdRoll ABM extends these capabilities with account-based precision, multi-touch campaigns, and real-time buyer intelligence. Backed by nearly 20 years of data and award-winning support, AdRoll enables marketing teams to advertise smarter, move faster, and achieve more, all from one place.

companies.name: AegisAI
companies.description: Aegis AI develops an AI-native email security platform that helps organizations detect and respond to email-based cyber threats. The platform uses coordinated AI agents to analyze email content, sender behavior, and communication patterns to identify phishing attempts, business email compromise, malware, ransomware, spam, and other evolving threats. It integrates with email services such as Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 through APIs, allowing deployment without requiring changes to existing mail routing. The platform provides automated threat detection, quarantine and remediation capabilities, along with reporting and visibility into targeted attacks and security trends. Aegis AI also supports security teams by reducing manual review efforts and adapting to emerging email threats through AI-driven analysis rather than relying solely on static rules or signatures.
locations: Union Square, New York, NY, USA

companies.name: Agave
companies.description: Agave provides a unified API for accessing data across all construction software systems, such as Procore, BIM 360, QuickBooks Online, and others. Agave's software combines project management, financial, and bidding platform tools, allowing developers to access all available data.
